chunks.title: Türkiye İş Bankası (İşbank) (İşbank) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Türkiye İş Bankası (İşbank) is a Turkish Commercial Bank headquartered in Türkiye. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Official COP31 Climate Supporter at Climate Finance Hub; showcasing energy transition, green industrialization & marine conservation models. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: COP31 Climate Finance Hub green transformation, SME packages, energy transition, sustainable tourism & blue economy financing models. Source verification: https://www.bolgegundemi.com/antalya/bankalar-cop31-kapsaminda-iklim-finansmani-modellerini-tanitacak-229994.html.

chunks.title: İşbank Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Türkiye İş Bankası (İşbank) provides the following climate financing instruments: Green Investment Loan, SME Eco-Efficiency Loan, Blue Economy / Sustainable Tourism Loan, Project Finance, Green Trade Credit. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 100,000 to USD 150,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, SME, Mid-Cap Enterprise, Project SPV, Climate-Tech Startup.

chunks.title: İşbank Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Türkiye İş Bankası (İşbank): Renewable Energy, Industrial Decarbonization, Blue Economy & Marine Conservation, Sustainable Tourism, SME Green Transition, Energy Efficiency. Target geographic focus includes: Türkiye, EMEA. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: İşbank Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete İşbank's application form: Turkish legal entity (VKN) & credit bureau clearance; Eligible green transition, renewable, or blue-economy use of proceeds; Environmental permits (ÇED/EIA) & supplier green equipment specs; Collateral / KGF guarantee verification. Explicit exclusion rules: Unabated coal power; Marine ecosystem degradation. Official application portal: https://www.isbank.com.tr/en/about-us/sustainability.

chunks.title: İşbank Form Template: Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application
chunks.text: Türkiye İş Bankası (İşbank) uses the 'Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application' workflow governed by BRSA (BDDK) Sustainable Banking Guidelines, Turkish Green Taxonomy & EU CBAM Readiness. Typical review timeline is 1–4 weeks (Branch/Corporate RM Intake -> Green Eligibility Check -> Credit Approval). Form sections required: 1. Applicant Identification, 2. Product Selection, 3. Green Technical Criteria, 4. Credit & Collateral, 5. Compliance, 6. Summary.
